notes: Each label is a named code section timed via vofluid-core's profiling module. avg/min/max/total are lifetime stats since the app started (not windowed). recent_ms is a bounded rolling window (oldest first) of per-frame mean durations for that label, capped at a fixed length regardless of session length so this file stays small. Labels whose name ends in a pass/loop name (e.g. gather_pass, pressure_pass) represent a whole per-particle loop aggregated into one sample per frame, not a single call — see each label's `count`, which is the number of underlying items (e.g. particles) summed across every frame, not the number of frames. Higher total_ms relative to other labels means that section is a bigger share of overall frame cost; compare avg_ms across labels to find the current bottleneck, and compare max_ms to avg_ms within a label to spot spikes/stutter.
